observed_anchor: Current ClayVM globally rejects non-Int OP_HOSTCALL arguments. The retained PR #744 moves exact scalar hostcall type enforcement to each host handler; the independent counterarchitecture preserved the global Int-only VM hostcall fence and encoded only one semantic String executable path across a bounded Int ABI.
retained_hypothesis: Transport canonical scalar Clay values through OP_HOSTCALL and require every admitted hostcall handler to enforce its exact signature. This directly enables String transport and avoids backend byte-vector encoding for the path-only slice.
counterhypothesis: Preserve the existing global Int-only VM hostcall fence and lower one semantic String executable-path literal into a bounded length-prefixed UTF-8 byte vector carried as Int values to a dedicated hostcall. This minimizes generic VM type-surface widening but does not provide dynamic String transport.

mechanism_tradeoff.retained_pr_744: Simpler semantic String transport and a more general scalar hostcall substrate, but correctness depends on every current/future host handler enforcing exact argument types after the global VM fence is removed.
mechanism_tradeoff.closed_pr_745: Preserves the current generic VM Int-only fail-closed fence and keeps legacy hostcalls unchanged, but introduces a dedicated physical ABI encoding, adds stack arguments proportional to UTF-8 path length, and cannot satisfy general dynamic String/argv transport.

unusual_experiment.name: NUL_BEARING_STRING_PROCESS_PATH_REJECTION
unusual_experiment.input_class: semantic String executable path containing NUL plus sandbox marker suffix
unusual_experiment.interpretation: The counterarchitecture reused the canonical host-process NUL fence and rejected the invalid path before Linux process execution.

coordination.action: PR #745 closed unmerged; independent mechanism and exact local replication transferred to PR #744 discussion.
coordination.reason: Parallel equivalent or competing implementation lanes must not become simultaneous canonical paths.

entityos.next_executable_action: Run retained PR #744 on an actually-started isolated full-repository sandbox with the canonical reproducible one-file EntityOS build, exact EntityOS self-test and moved-copy run. Compare the retained generic scalar hostcall mechanism against the preserved counterarchitecture specifically on fail-closed wrong-type behavior before promotion; then continue toward canonical argv aggregate plus Bytes/Buffer ownership/lifetime.
